_meta.purpose: Audit trail for SUPERSEDED pre-registrations. Entries here were active when their underlying algo was deployed/paused; they were retired when the algo was archived. Validators (validate-preregistration.ts, validate-algo.ts) DO NOT read this file — it exists purely for forensic reference. Each entry preserves its full original criteria + adds {superseded_at, superseded_by_phase, superseded_reason}.
_meta.schema_note: Each key is the algorithm name (matches algorithms.name at time of pre-registration). Entries are not Zod-validated by validate-preregistration.ts because they live in a separate file. If a future revival of an archived algo needs to re-register, COPY the entry back into preregistration.json, drop the superseded_* fields, refresh registered_at + expires_at, and submit through the standard pre-registration flow.
